name: GhostDrawer
description: Themed wrappers around headless GhostDrawer, GhostDrawerTrigger, GhostDrawerOverlay, GhostDrawerContent, GhostDrawerTitle, GhostDrawerDescription, and GhostDrawerClose. Importing from @ghostvue/themes loads the default elevation-4 edge panel, scrim, and reduced-motion-aware slide entry stylesheet.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state forwarded to headless GhostDrawer.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when open is omitted.

props.name: modal
props.description: Enables modal behavior (trapped focus, scroll lock, inert background, overlay).

props.name: side
props.description: Viewport edge forwarded to headless GhostDrawer ('start', 'end', 'top', 'bottom').

props.name: dir
props.description: Explicit writing direction for mapping logical start/end sides.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Drawer trigger, overlay, content, title, description, and close parts.

parts.name: overlay
parts.description: Full-viewport backdrop rendered by GhostDrawerOverlay with data-themed.

parts.name: content
parts.description: Edge-anchored elevation-4 drawer surface rendered by GhostDrawerContent with data-themed; positioned from data-side and data-dir.

parts.name: description
parts.description: Muted supporting description rendered by GhostDrawerDescription.

states.name: open
states.description: Applied to trigger, overlay, and content while open.

states.name: side
states.description: data-side on trigger, overlay, and content selects the anchored edge.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-scrim
cssProperties.description: Shared semantic backdrop color of GhostDrawerOverlay, supplied by the theme.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-text-muted
cssProperties.description: Muted text color applied to GhostDrawerDescription.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-space-inset-lg
cssProperties.description: Internal padding and viewport margin of GhostDrawerContent.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-space-gap-md
cssProperties.description: Vertical spacing between sections inside GhostDrawerContent.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-focus-ring-color
cssProperties.description: Outer focus-visible outline color when content receives focus.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-motion-enter-duration
cssProperties.description: Slide and fade entry duration when motion is allowed.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-motion-enter-easing
cssProperties.description: Slide and fade entry easing when motion is allowed.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-motion-fade-duration
cssProperties.description: Opacity-only entry duration under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-motion-easing-standard
cssProperties.description: Opacity-only entry easing under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

keyboard.Enter: Opens or toggles the drawer when focused on the trigger, or closes when focused on GhostDrawerClose.
keyboard.Space: Opens or toggles the drawer when focused on the trigger, or closes when focused on GhostDrawerClose.
keyboard.Escape: Dismisses the topmost open drawer when closeOnEscape is true and restores focus.
